svg.title: Fair field-backend comparison keeps exact instance and cost boundaries visible
svg.desc: One exact degree-83 polynomial field, subgroup, generator and target are bound by native inputs. Representation and arithmetic kernel differ from walk/collision policy. Default rho, selected rho and retained IC disclose their applied backend, code path and charged conversion, setup, target work and replay. Rho has a 60-second process cap and IC has 1800 seconds; those stop envelopes are unequal. No optimization result is shown.
svg.text: One exact instance, explicit implementation opportunities

Lane, jump, distinguished-point and cycle settings
Prepared state, target starts, walk and recovery
Policy changes are distinct from shared field improvements.
PER ARM: DEFAULT RHO / SELECTED RHO / RETAINED IC
Name the applied backend and actual code path; declare rho-only versus shared opportunities.
Charge conversion + reusable setup + all target-dependent attempts + scalar replay at their declared boundaries.
Keep complete online intervals, native residuals, process wall, child CPU and peak RSS as separate records.
Stop envelopes: rho 60 s process cap; IC 1800 s for setup. They are unequal and must remain explicit.
IC rank seed 29 is not a probe limit; extraction traverses full index.states once, with no 20-million-probe cap.
Diagram only; no field-backend or policy optimization result is claimed.
